name: Yaksha
source:
Greater Demon

A Greater Demon with disruptive plans. Willing to go to extreme lengths in search of an artifact referred to as the Imperial Key. Intent on releasing the seal, regardless of what it might take.

[i]"My name is Yaksha, and you will hand over the Imperial Key so that I can release the seal. And if you won't... you will all be annihilated."[/i]

[From [url=https://games.sega.com/sakurawars/lang/en/]SEGA[/url]]
